description.en: Registers `openai-codex` and `anthropic` LLM routes from the OAuth credentials the local Codex CLI and Claude Code already hold, refreshing the token near expiry and showing each subscription's remaining quota in a web panel.
description.zh: 复用本机 Codex CLI 与 Claude Code 已持有的 OAuth 凭据注册 `openai-codex` 与 `anthropic` LLM 路由，在临近过期时刷新 token，并在 Web 面板中显示各订阅的剩余额度。
